
```{r}
rbind(nflgames, all_info_postseason)|>left_join(final_teams, by = c("home_team" = "team_abbr"))|>left_join(final_teams, by = c("away_team" = "team_abbr")) -> master_nflschedule

#master_nflschedule|>save(file = "master_nflschedule.RData")
```

```{r}
data<- master_nflschedule
ui<-fluidPage(title = "NFL Upset Predictor", 
              selectInput("team", "NFL Team", c("All",unique(nflgames$home_team))),
              sliderInput("temp", "Temperature", -10, 110, c(-10,110)),
              sliderInput("wind", "Wind Speed", 0, 71, c(0,71)),
              radioButtons("location", "Home vs. Away (Must pick a team)", c("Both", "Home", "Away")),
              radioButtons("rival", "Rivalry Games (Must pick a team)", c("Both", "Rivalries", "Non-Rivalries")),
              radioButtons("playoff", "Select:", c("Both", "Regular Season Games", "Postseason Games")),
              selectInput("rest_time", "Maxiumum Rest Time (Days) (Must pick a team)", c(21, 14, 7)),
              plotOutput("p")
        )


server<-function(input, output, session){
  filtered_data<-reactive({
    data<- master_nflschedule
    if (input$team != "All"){
      data <- master_nflschedule |> filter(home_team == input$team | away_team == input$team)
    }
    if(input$playoff == "Regular Season Games") {
      data <- data |> filter(game_type == "REG")
    } else if(input$playoff == "Postseason Games") {
      data <- data |> filter(game_type != "REG")
    }
    data <- data |> filter(between(temp, input$temp[1], input$temp[2]) | 
                             (roof == "dome" | roof == "closed")) |>
      filter(between(wind, input$wind[1], input$wind[2]) | 
               (roof == "dome" | roof == "closed"))
    if(input$team != "All") {
      if (input$location == "Home") {
        data <- data |> filter(home_team == input$team)
      } else if (input$location == "Away") {
        data <- data |> filter(away_team == input$team)
      }
      if (input$rival == "Rivalries") {
        data <- data |> filter(team_division.x == team_division.y)
      } else if (input$rival == "Non-Rivalries") {
        data <- data |> filter(team_division.x != team_division.y)
      }
      if(input$rest_time == "7") {
        data <- data |> filter((home_team == input$team & home_rest <= 7) | 
                               (away_team == input$team & away_rest <= 7)) 
                               
      } else if (input$rest_time == "14") {
        data <- data |> filter((home_team == input$team & home_rest <= 14) | 
                               (away_team == input$team & away_rest <= 14))
      } else if (input$rest_time == "21") {
        data <- data |> filter((home_team == input$team & home_rest <= 21) | 
                               (away_team == input$team & away_rest <= 21))
      }
    }
    print(nrow(data))
    data
    })
  output$p <- renderPlot({
    final_data <- filtered_data() 
    upsets<- final_data|> mutate(upset = ((spread_line >= 3.5 & margin < 0) | (spread_line <= -3.5 & margin > 0)))
    
    upsets|> ggplot(aes(x = spread_line, fill = upset)) + geom_histogram()
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r}
# negative spread is away team is favored

upsets<- nflgames|>arrange(spread_line)|>dplyr::select(home_team, away_team, home_score, away_score, margin, spread_line)|> filter((spread_line >= 6.5 & margin < 0) | (spread_line <= -6.5 & margin > 0))
upsets

#504 upsets total


all_nfl_games_betting<- nflgames|>filter(!is.na(margin) | is.na(spread_line))


head(all_nfl_games_betting)


#proportion of upsets
nrow(upsets)/nrow(all_nfl_games_betting)

```

```{r}
money_margin<- seq(14.5, -14.5, by = -0.5)

final_upset<-c()
for (i in money_margin){
  upsets_temp<- nflgames|>dplyr::select(home_team, away_team, home_score, away_score, margin, spread_line)|> filter((spread_line >= i & margin < 0) | (spread_line <= -i & margin > 0))
  prop_upset = nrow(upsets_temp)/nrow(all_nfl_games_betting)
  final_upset <- c(final_upset, prop_upset)
}
df<-data.frame(cutoff = money_margin, upset_prop = final_upset)

ggplot()+geom_line(aes(x = cutoff, y = upset_prop), data = df) +geom_vline(xintercept = 6.5, color = "red")

```
```{r}
#away teams being upset
upset_while_away<- upsets|>filter(margin>0)|>count(away_team)|>arrange(n)

upset_while_home<- upsets|>filter(margin<0)|>count(home_team)|>arrange(n)

left_join(upset_while_away, upset_while_home, by =c("away_team" ="home_team"))|>mutate(total_upsets = n.x+n.y)|>arrange(-total_upsets)
```
